# flnet

**Net control operator's list — who checked in, in what order**

- **Version recorded:** 7.5.0
- **Categories:** `emcomm`, `logging`, `station`
- **Upstream:** <https://w1hkj.org/>

## What it does

Keeps the roster for a directed net: a database of regular members with callsign, name and location, a check-in list built as stations call in, ordering and re-ordering of who is waiting, and a printed or exported record afterwards.

## Why you would want it

Running a net means tracking twenty callsigns in the order they arrived while also operating, and paper falls apart the moment somebody re-checks-in or has traffic. This is the tool net control operators actually use, and its member database means a regular's name and location fill themselves in from the callsign.

## Before it will work

Nothing to start; the member database is built as you go or imported. Integration with fllog and fldigi is over XML-RPC and is optional.

## How it installs

- source (autotools) from https://w1hkj.org/files/flnet/flnet-7.5.0.tar.gz
  - build dependencies: `build-essential`, `pkg-config`, `libfltk1.3-dev`
  - Build dependencies are MEASURED, not copied. Built in a Debian 13 container on 2026-08-28 with build-essential, pkg-config and libfltk1.3-dev and nothing else: configure exits 0, make exits 0, and the binary appears. AHRL lists extra packages for some of these (libpng-dev and libxft-dev for flcluster, libsamplerate0-dev for flnet); they are not needed, because libfltk1.3-dev already pulls what the build uses. This is the same over-specification the fldigi manifest records for libportaudio-ocaml-dev. The sha256 is ours. Upstream publishes checksums for its Windows installers only -- w1hkj.org/files/sha256vals.txt lists .exe files and no source tarballs -- so this digest was computed from the tarball fetched from the project's own site on 2026-08-28. It pins the exact bytes that were reviewed and built, which is the guarantee actually on offer; it is not an upstream signature and this manifest does not imply one.

Binaries this produces:

- `src/flnet`

## Known problems

Built for directed nets with a controller; it is not a contest log and not a general station log. The member database is a local file -- back it up, because for a long-running net it represents years of accumulated detail. Not packaged on any target. Debian carries `libflxmlrpc-dev` at 0.1.4 and this build asks pkg-config for flxmlrpc >= 1.0.1, so the system library is NOT used: configure falls back to the copy bundled in the tarball and its summary line reads "Have flxmlrpc library ....... internal lib". Measured, not inferred. Installing libflxmlrpc-dev alongside would change nothing, which is why it is not a build dependency here.
